_about: Routes allowed to sit outside the versioned API contract. tests/test_openapi_contract.py fails when a route is registered outside /api/v<N> and is not in outside_version_prefix, or is under /api/v<N> but hidden from the OpenAPI document and is not in not_in_openapi. Every entry needs a reason. An entry with "conditional": true may be absent (it is registered only when an optional package is installed). See docs/adr/0006-api-contract.md.
